entry.author: NZ Defence Force
entry.summary:
Behind every flight is a dedicated team of maintainers. 

No. 14 Squadron is supported by Beechcraft New Zealand and Airbus New Zealand to keep our Air Force’s T-6C Texan II fleet maintained and ready to fly.

Throughout the summer display season, the aircraft are flown by the RNZAF Black Falcons. Year-round, they are the capability used in training the next generation of Royal New Zealand Air Force and Royal New Zealand Navy pilots, as well as future flying instructors.
